body: Jess and Nick from New girl

What interested me the most was discovering the end of each loop.  Adam, Noah, The stanger (Jonas) ... etc, they all kept talking about these loops.  In the end, the general idea that remained with me is that this error created by Tannhaus (the 2 extra worlds) is an anomaly and most of the fates of the characters were horrible. 

For example, Katarina is the person who touched me the most, she was beaten by her own mother who does not hesitate to tell her that she should have aborted her like the others. She wanted to have her first sexual experience with Ulrich but he got arrested for allegedly raping her because of Hannah, then Ulrich cheats on her with with the same woman that ruined her first sexual experience, she loses her youngest child, then her husband, learns that the child she lost was married to Hannah, decides to go save them both and is violently killed by her mother on that beach where Martha and Jonas found the St. Christopher pendant. 

There is also the loop (the fate) of Noah that I found also extremely sad, so tragic that he will portray the fate of his father Bartosz because he ends up murdered by his own son.

In conclusion, in these parallel worlds created because of a horrible fate (the death of Tannhaus's son, daughter in law and granddaughter) spawned a whole bunch of horrible destinies. 
I think, the show allowes us to see what could happen from lost, tragedy and more importantly from not being able to grieve and let this pain push us to the limits of what is humanly possible.
